question: CD is a tangent to a circle of circumference of 88 cm with its centre at O. OC cuts the circle at P while OD cuts circle at V such that ∠COD = 90°. Length of PC is 6 cm. What is half of CD (in cm) if OD exceeds OC by 1 cm?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Radius r = (88 × 7) ÷ (2 × 22) = 14 cm.

OC = r + PC = 14 + 6 = 20 cm.

OD = OC + 1 = 21 cm.

CD = √(20² + 21²) = √(400 + 441) = 29 cm.

Half of CD = 29 ÷ 2 = 14.5 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 14.5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Circumference = 88 cm

PC = 6 cm, OD = OC + 1 cm

∠COD = 90°

Circumference = 2 × π × r
